cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: How Much Do You Know?
cards.instruction: Probe for what others know while revealing as little as possible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. When you say you heard about the party, which part?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cake went over the balcony. Was that before you left?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Who gave you the timing?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody. Your brother says there's a video.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Have you watched it, or are we both relying on my brother?

mechanism: A poses as the only competent assessor of evidence, correcting hearsay while probing what B actually knows about A involvement without supplying timing.
confusable: Ordinary evasiveness lacks exact patient distinctions between questions, reports and firsthand evidence.
comparison: Keys alternative probes identification and action; party alternative probes timing and an unwatched video.
seedUse: Party seed has a strong knowledge probe; preserve its actual questions and make S03 work through source-quality corrections.
